name: RAID0 over the instance store NVMe disks (or the single disk) at /local

tasks.name: take apart the DLAMI's LVM over the instance store, build RAID0 (or use the single disk), mount at /local
commands: DEVS=$(lsblk -dno NAME,MODEL | awk '/Instance Storage/ {print "/dev/"$1}' | tr '\n' ' '); echo "devices: $DEVS" | tee $D/devices.txt

systemctl stop dlami-nvme.service 2>/dev/null || true; for m in $(findmnt -nro TARGET /opt/dlami/nvme 2>/dev/null) $(lsblk -nro MOUNTPOINT $DEVS 2>/dev/null); do umount -l $m || true; done; for vg in $(vgs --noheadings -o vg_name 2>/dev/null); do vgremove -ff -y $vg || true; done; for x in $DEVS; do pvremove -ff -y $x 2>/dev/null || true; wipefs -a $x > /dev/null 2>&1 || true; done; for md in /dev/md[0-9]*; do [ -b $md ] && mdadm --stop $md 2>/dev/null || true; done
if [ $N -eq 1 ]; then DEV=$DEVS; else mdadm --create /dev/md0 --run --level=0 --raid-devices=$N $DEVS; DEV=/dev/md0; fi
